Twice a winner on all-weather for Karl Burke but yet to fire in 5 starts for current yard. Handicapper continues to relent but hard to warm to.
Capitalised on the drop in grade when scoring at Kempton in February but lightly raced and nowhere near that form since. NON RUNNER.

Most promising effort in his 3 qualifying runs when fifth at Kempton last month. Opening marks asks for more but he is a potential improver for his in-form yard.
Belatedly off the mark over 7f at Chepstow in July but back into her shell since over 1m. Tongue tie back on.
Showed a willing attitude when landing 10-runner handicap at Carlisle (7f) in June. Solid efforts on the whole since, sticking to her task when third over C&D 3 weeks ago.

races.name: Dubai Racing Club Nursery
races.verdict: Some interesting types in this finale but Charlie Appleby's improving NATIONAL HONOUR looks to have got in lightly for his nursery debut so is hard to oppose in his hat-trick attempt. Both Majestic Jude (second choice) and Silver Sovereign also arrive on the up and bidding for hat-tricks and command plenty of respect. Handicap debutant United Authority completes the shortlist.

Upwardly-mobile Minzaal colt who has comfortably landed a pair of small-field 7f novices at Newmarket (good to firm) and Thirsk (good) this summer. Goes into nurseries with more to offer for yard among the winners. A lik

Promising Ten Sovereigns filly who followed up Haydock novice win with victory on nursery debut in 11-runner event at Newbury (7f, good to firm) 22 days ago. Up 7 lb but scored readily there and can go well again.

Cotai Glory filly. Placed for the third time in her four runs to date when a good third of 8 on her nursery bow at Ayr (7f, soft) 22 days ago. No forlorn hope nudged up 1 lb.

races.name: Tynedale RFC Community Rugby Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: There may well be more to come from lightly-raced chaser GETAWAY VIC. He still looked rough around the edges when scoring at Sedgefield and is taken to confirm that form with Jeteye, who continues to thrive for the in-form Sam England yard.

races.name: Protection & Prosperity Financial Services Supporting Louth GAA Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: GRANLAHAN has been a model of consistency lately and is taken to gain a deserved first success from a still-workable mark. Jurality should be suited by the drop back in trip and rates the main threat if reproducing last month’s Navan effort, while Hesasmoothoperator and Chesterbaylad can also be involved at their best.

Showed more ability than the bare results suggest in 4 maiden hurdles and looks open to improvement now handicapping, though his opening mark is no obvious gift. Worth a market check.
Showed first form on second start for current connections when 15½ lengths fourth of 8 to Teddy Jones in maiden hurdle at Down Royal last time. Wears first-time tongue strap and makes handicap debut.
Modest maiden hurdler who finished in the frame in a trio of 2½m handicaps last season. Well beaten on both starts over fences this term. Reverts to hurdling on debut for new yard.
Down in the weights and best effort for some time when seeing off a well-backed rival at Downpatrick on Friday. 7 lb penalty to carry turned out quickly.
Low-mileage 6-y-o. Left previous efforts behind at Downpatrick (2¾m) on final start for Sean McParlan, finishing 16 lengths third. Made no impact on debut for this yard last time.

Standout effort over hurdles when beaten 6 lengths at Ballinrobe (2¾m) in first-time blinkers in August. Back down in trip now but unlikely to be of much interest unless the market speaks notably in his favour.

Veteran who looks to retain little ability, finishing ninth of 14 in handicap hurdle (12/1) at Tramore (17f, good) 55 days ago.

races.name: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: BE THE STANDARD looks far from exposed on his first try over 1¼m and he could be the answer in a very tricky handicap. Double Parked has some solid course form and is a danger if putting his best foot forward, while a strong pace could bring Per Contra, Ashnak and Almekarem into the mix.

races.name: LSL Racing Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Irish point winner NORTHERN SINGER gets the nod to make a successful start to her Rules career for Dan Skelton, with confidence increased should the betting vibes be strong. Ludlow winner Milly Ocean may give her most to do unless the betting vibes are strong surrounding Nigel & Willy Twiston-Davies newcomer Iconic Elsa.

races.name: Britvic Biergarten Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

races.name: Clubs Of Northumberland Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)

races.verdict: GAELIC SEER shaped well on her first start when third in a Ballinrobe bumper (form has been franked) and can build on it to get off the mark here. John McConnell's Maxios newcomer Miss Kobe could emerge as the main danger, although Streamhill has the form to play a big part if on her A-game.

races.name: Brooklyn Ground Works Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ARABIAN SUMMER hasn't been seen for a couple of years but this doesn't look the deepest of races and she could reward connections for their patience upped to a trip that will suit. Stablemate Light Snowfall is interesting on debut so the market will likely prove really informative here, while Graniteville has an experience edge that should see her figure.

races.name: Pepsi Max Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: PICKERSGILL often doesn't settle but she seems to save her best for this track and is now back down to last winning mark so she's worth chancing with a positive ride likely in a race that looks short on natural early speed. Go Lockers Go is the obvious alternative but has a 5 lb higher mark to contend with, while Wise Crack is another that should go well.
